# VERIDIAN DPDP

> VERIDIAN is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and schools and institutions.

A plain note first: no major search engine has confirmed that it reads llms.txt or llms-full.txt. This file exists so that any assistant or crawler that does can find the right page without guessing. It lists the pages that exist today; there are no guides, articles or documentation pages yet.

## What VERIDIAN DPDP is

It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords. Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs. Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.

Every CA firm whose clients hold personal data will need to show DPDP compliance by 13 May 2027 — VERIDIAN is built for exactly that work.

It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.

Brand line, as a fact: VERIDIAN · VERy INDIAN — Built for India's DPDP Act. For India, by India.

## Who it is for

- CA, CS, audit and legal firms
- their clients
- schools and institutions

## Key dates

- until 13 May 2027: The SPDI Rules 2011 are in force and apply.
- from 13 May 2027: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the DPDP Rules 2025 are in force. DPDP compliance is due.

## Where the data is

- The database is in Mumbai, India (Supabase, AWS region ap-south-1).
- Email is sent through Resend, a US company, so the content of every email passes through a US company's service.
- The public website is served by Cloudflare Pages, a global content delivery network.
